title: Matrices as arrays
hints: Arrays of comparable elements can be compared directly with ==, and a parameter of array type is already a private copy.
Transposing in place by swapping m[i][j] with m[j][i] for every i and j swaps each pair twice, which puts it back. Write into a separate result array instead.
Equal: return a == b. Transpose: var t [3][3]int; for i := range 3 { for j := range 3 { t[j][i] = m[i][j] } }; return t.
